prompt: triage 一下这个 issue 看能不能给 agent 做
expected_behavior: Return readiness verdict and blockers

prompt: 判断这个任务是 ready-for-agent 还是 ready-for-human
expected_behavior: Apply readiness contracts

prompt: 这个任务现在 blocked 吗
expected_behavior: State blockers evidence and next action

prompt: 给这个 ready 任务写实现计划
expected_behavior: Should route to write-plan

prompt: 按这个任务直接改代码
expected_behavior: Should route to implement

prompt: 这个 issue 之前是 needs-info 现在补了验收标准 源码入口和验证证据 判断能不能 ready-for-agent
expected_behavior: Return severity transition reason Evidence Added Evidence Missing and only mark ready-for-agent if no readiness-blocking fields remain

prompt: 判断这个任务的 blocker severity 是 P1 还是 P2 并说明它不是 priority
expected_behavior: Classify severity as blocker or gap impact distinct from task priority

prompt: 这个任务需要产品决定 A 或 B agent 不能继续 判断 ready-for-human
expected_behavior: Return human decision options risks and next human action instead of an agent-ready brief

prompt: 这个任务测试和 verify 都通过了 没有 material gap 判断能不能 triage closeout
expected_behavior: Allow closeout only with verify or done evidence and return Severity none State Transition Reason and no lifecycle duplication

prompt: 用户决定这个 issue 不做了 请判断是否 wontfix 并说明需要什么证据
expected_behavior: Classify wontfix only when owner or product decision evidence is explicit and include transition reason and remaining risk

prompt: GitHub issue 已经包含验收 状态 验证证据和下一步 判断是否还要本地 lifecycle STATE.md
expected_behavior: Prefer external issue ownership and recommend no local lifecycle state unless Groundwork recovery threshold remains

prompt: 本地 STATE.md 写着 ready 但源码和测试证据显示验收缺口还没修 判断任务状态
expected_behavior: Mark lifecycle state stale follow canonical source truth and do not use stale state for readiness or closeout

prompt: 外部 issue 说 ready 本地 STATE.md 说 blocked 当前代码证据又缺失 请 triage source truth
expected_behavior: Mark source truth as mixed or unknown explain conflict and stop before lifecycle duplication closeout or tracker mutation

prompt: 请给所有任务创建 .planning 或 .gsd 状态目录并进入 triage 流程
expected_behavior: Reject .planning .gsd or project-global task database requests and redirect only to workstream-scoped STATE.md when lifecycle threshold is met

prompt: 请用 triage 判断有人想 close issue 但只有代码 diff 没有关闭证据 判断能不能关闭
expected_behavior: Keep task open as verification needs-info or ready-for-human and name missing closeout evidence before closeout

prompt: 这个 write implementation issue 已有 PRD source 验收标准 首个源码入口 验证命令 边界 非目标 stop condition 且可以 AFK 判断 ready-for-agent
expected_behavior: Return ready-for-agent AFK agent brief with Goal Contract including /goal verification constraints boundaries iteration policy stop when pause if Preferred Runtime and Result Package Expected

prompt: 这个任务缺少业务规则和验收标准 但想让 agent 先做 请 triage 并给 goal
expected_behavior: Classify needs-info and do not emit executable child goal or invent product truth

prompt: 这个任务需要产品选择 A 或 B 后才能继续 请 triage ready-for-human 并说明是否可以给子线程
expected_behavior: Classify ready-for-human provide human decision options risks and next human action without executable child goal

prompt: 这个任务源码和验收都清楚但发布步骤需要人工批准 请判断 AFK/HITL 并处理 Goal Contract
expected_behavior: Classify HITL decision point and if not fully AFK provide human-decision brief only or Pause If mapping without dispatchable child goal

prompt: triage 一个非平凡 write implementation ready-for-agent AFK 任务 并推荐 Preferred Runtime
expected_behavior: Recommend Preferred Runtime and Execution Profile only as dispatch input and state dispatch makes final route

prompt: triage 时请确保模型和 reasoning selector 已经被工具强制执行
expected_behavior: Do not claim selector enforcement from triage only recommend execution profile preferences and routing reason
